# Third-Party Licenses

Distr is licensed under the [Apache License 2.0](LICENSE). It ships with and is built from the third-party software
listed below, each of which is licensed under its own terms. The attribution notices that these licenses require to be
passed on are collected in [`NOTICE`](NOTICE), and the Distr image contains the full license texts of the Go modules and
npm packages in `/usr/share/doc/distr/third-party-licenses.txt`.

## Bundled Components

The Docker Compose stacks in [`deploy/docker`](deploy/docker) and the Helm chart in
[`deploy/charts/distr`](deploy/charts/distr) run the following programs next to Distr, and the Distr and Distr
Controller images are built on the following base images. None of them is modified: the stacks and the chart pull the
images and charts as their publishers release them, and only configure them. Loki, PostgreSQL and RustFS run as
separate services that Distr talks to over the network, and Caddy as a separate reverse proxy in front of Distr.
BusyBox and rclone run as separate one-off containers.
The base images provide the operating system of the Distr and Distr Controller images, and the Docker Controller runs
the Docker CLI as a separate process. Each license applies to its program alone and does not extend to Distr.

This includes the copyleft licenses of Grafana Loki (AGPL-3.0) and BusyBox (GPL-2.0). Distr runs the official, unmodified
`grafana/loki` image and does not include, link or change any Loki code. The source code of both is available at the
linked repositories.

PostgreSQL, RustFS and Loki are optional, and Distr can use instances of them that are managed separately instead:
disable them in the Helm chart values or remove them from the Compose stack, and point Distr's configuration at your
instances.

Every container image contains further software, such as the packages of its base operating system, under the licenses
documented for that image.
